The 4 KB LUT6 Page & 16 KB Nucleus [T/E/M · measured_j]

- Yosys + openXC7 closes 320.62 MHz post-PAR timing with (72,64) SECDED
- Unprobed DS181 model: 0.86 est_W / 55.2 est_C with DDR3 off, but flags 95.8 est_C (>85 C limit) thermal failure if DDR3+PCIe run in a 0 LFM slot
